text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Jordan-san!
Please teach me how to dance!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, me?
...Why?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Buena-chan, you're better than me.
Honestly, I feel like you should be teaching me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
No way! Jordan-san, your dancing
is so gorgeous and wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I saw your Umatok video.
It somehow made my heart leap with joy...
I want to dance just like you!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Seriously?
Is my dancing... really that good?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
If we're going for a Umatok vibe...
Then how about it? Wanna do a super hype dance?!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yes, please go right ahead! I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, as I passed by near the dance studio...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Colorful light leaks through the crack in the studio door.
Curious, I peek inside to see..."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaay! That's awesome~!
Way to go, Buena-chan!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!! Look, look!!
Isn't Buena-chan insane? For real so cute~!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Jordan-san was teaching me.
—The 'Hype AF' dance!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yep! Buena-chan's a quick learner and super fun to be around~. She's seriously perfect.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Come on, Buena-chan, wahey~

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy~!
...Heheâª

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista strikes poses with total enthusiasm.
Such an open and carefree demeanor is rare for her.
choice_data_list: A different vibe from usual suits you too.
A different vibe from usual suits you too.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh... Is it really that different?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "Did I maybe... go a little too far?"
choice_data_list: Not at all, that's not true.
Not at all, that's not true.
Because it was different from usual, it had a special shine.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "Did I maybe... go a little too far?"
choice_data_list: Not at all, that's not true.
Not at all, that's not true.
Because it was different from usual, it had a special shine.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Really?
Glad to hear that, then!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, going all in is key too, right? Alright,
let's do UmaTok! Trainer, film this for me~

text_block_list.name: Buena & Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, nice. I'm really getting into the groove.
Buena-chan, you cool to go a bit longer?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course!
I'll give it my all with maximum hype!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Tosen Jordan, Buena Vista
was able to master a fresh new dance style.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"No, for real, she's super cute.
That gap moe is unreal."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The contrast...
So that's what made it good?
choice_data_list: She felt like a brand-new Buena.
She felt like a brand-new Buena!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Really?
That makes me happy then♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! I'm about to take an UmaTok video with Jordan-san.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Since you're here, won't you watch?
I want to show off the fruits of my practice!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That fan service is insane.
